ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with approximately 10-15% high-intensity (white/grey) pixels concentrated in linear patterns and distal mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity pixels are distributed as parallel horizontal streaks on the mid-right lobe, vertical/diagonal streaks on the left lobe, and mottled clusters at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped notch with an approximate 50-degree aperture and significant depth relative to the fluke centerline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Generally smooth contour in the medial sections, transitioning to irregular serrations at the tips, with a distinct semicircular indentation on the upper trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature sweeping upward and outward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast circular textured clusters (barnacle colonization) localized on the outer margins of both the left and right distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous horizontal parallel linear markings on the right lobe surface and scattered diagonal linear marks on the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent semicircular notch or missing segment on the upper trailing edge of the left lobe; extensive barnacle growth on both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized white mottling visible at the base of the fluke where it meets the water surface.
